description: Download a job result that was delivered as a FILE (transferred P2P via iroh) to a local path. Use this after submit_and_pay_job or get_job_result reports a file result. Resumable and bounded by a max file size; the bytes are written to disk, never returned to you inline.

allow_outside_cwd.description: Allow writing outside the MCP server working directory. Off by default: the bytes come from an untrusted provider, so writes are confined to the working directory subtree (and never to a secret/auto-run path) unless this is set.

attachment_index.description: Which file to download when the result has MULTIPLE files (0-based; default 0). The download message reports the total count so you can fetch the others.

output_path.description: Local path to write the downloaded result file to.

name: fetch_job_file
